description: Damage Proxy Maps for the 2023 Maui wildfires and 2023 Morocco Earthquake is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Root. This dataset includes maps that show a proxy for damage due to earthquakes or other disruptions, called damage proxy maps. The maps are calculated from synthetic aperture radar data acquired by the ALOS-2 satellite operated by the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA). Coverage: Morocco. The portal files it under the publisher Root. The repository dates the deposit 2023; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
